problem_statement: Extend `KokkosBatched` Iamax with Team and TeamVector variants and unify them with the existing Serial interface. `SerialIamax::invoke(x)`, `TeamIamax<MemberType>::invoke(member, x)`, and `TeamVectorIamax<MemberType>::invoke(member, x)` must accept a one-dimensional view and return its `size_type`. Return the index of the first element having the largest absolute value; return 0 when the view has at most one element. Use the scalar type's appropriate absolute-value behavior. The Team and TeamVector forms must perform the reduction over execution-appropriate team or vector ranges and preserve first-location tie breaking.
title: Implement Team and TeamVector Iamax
